obligations.note: The ticket lists component "payments.reports" but controls/payments/components.json does not assign a component to apps/baseline-payments/payments/reports.py, so the change does not cover every component it touches.
Approval from Mara Costa (who has the change_approver role for payments) is recorded and she is not the author of the change.
The code_review approval applies only to the second commit; the first commit adds code (REPORT_FORMAT) and is not a comment‑only change, so a separate approval is required.
The CI run in records/ci/run.json is for the first commit, not the final head commit, yet the policy requires a successful full test suite on the final commit.
The security sensitivity of the reports component is not defined in components.json and no security_review approval is present, so we cannot determine whether the security‑review requirement applies.

summary: The change fails critical process obligations: missing component mapping (CHG‑1), insufficient approval coverage (CHG‑3), and CI not run on the final commit (CHG‑4). These violations require the change to be rejected.
